exact350Or360DistanceSnapshots.interpretation: Geometric observations only; a sampled distance and unchanged uses counter do not establish that an activation was attempted or rejected.

limitations: No UI or item activation input was observed by this analysis. Caller reports/screenshots must be linked separately.
The probe records tracker inventories, not summon-scroll inventories. Unchanged uses/readyAt alone cannot prove a rejected attempt or no scroll loss.
A uses increase plus movement is consistent with a completed summon but does not independently identify its initiating action or every safety check.
Dimension transitions are bracketed between approximately five-second snapshots. A round trip between samples can be missed.
The probe omits stored cross-dimension routes, so it cannot validate last-known-target direction from current coordinates alone.
Reconnect identities are anonymous roster indices. Joined/absent rows and phase changes do not establish the exact cause or automatic/manual resumption.
Cooldown/max-use rejection and cross-dimension no-move outcomes need corresponding activation and UI evidence.
This is ongoing evidence, not a final E2E or Stable pass.
